status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 71% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Golan Heights and Aleppo.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 71 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Golanhøydene og Aleppo.

summary.en: ISIS carried out a suicide bombing at an internal security site in Hasakah, killing two Syrian security force members, while separate attacks in Deir Ezzor and Daraa killed additional security personnel. Drone strikes in Suwayda wounded four security personnel, marking a second drone incident in the region this week. Israel shelled farmland in southwestern Syria, and Iran launched missiles at militants in response to a parade attack. Qatar and Canada reaffirmed support for Syria’s recovery and Palestinian rights. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: IS utførte et selvmordsbombeangrep på en intern sikkerhetsstasjon i Hasakah, og drepte to medlemmer av de syriske sikkerhetsstyrkene, mens separate angrep i Deir Ezzor og Daraa drepte ytterligere sikkerhetspersonell. Droneangrep i Suwayda såret fire sikkerhetspersonell, og markerer en andre dronehendelse i regionen denne uken. Israel skjøt på jordbruksområder i sørvestlige Syria, og Iran skjøt missiler mot militante som svar på et paradeangrep. Qatar og Canada bekreftet sin støtte til Syriens gjenoppbygging og palestinske rettigheter. UCDP registrerte 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
